system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: BP[build_prompt: RARV + SDLC + memory + queue + checklist]
system_prompt_style.note: build_prompt() in autonomy/run.sh assembles the prompt each iteration; line not available in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Navigation is delegated to the provider CLI (Claude Code etc.). The build_prompt source was not in the evidence bundle.

context_compaction.note: autonomy/context-tracker.py exists but its content is not in the evidence. LOKI_CAVEMAN compresses output tokens, which is not history compaction.

observation_format.note: Observations are handled inside the provider CLI; not described.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is delegated to the provider CLIs (claude, cline, codex, aider, opencode); the harness invokes the CLIs.

tool_count.note: The tool set belongs to the provider CLI. The separate MCP server exposes 36 tools, but those do not count under B2.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is performed by the provider CLI.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP server** -- 36 tools (including ChromaDB code search) plus 3 resources and 2 prompts (`mcp/server.py`
protocol_standardization.note: Loki ships an MCP server; autonomy/lib/mcp-config.sh also present.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The loop does not exit until the
verify stage clears
loop_primitives.note: RARV iteration loop: invoke provider, then verify, then repeat. The provider itself runs a ReAct loop. Blind 3-reviewer council coded as review. multi_attempt is a weak coding (retries).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: BP[build_prompt: RARV + SDLC + memory + queue + checklist]
planning_granularity.note: The task queue and PRD checklist persist across iterations (autonomy/prd-checklist.sh).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: These are prompt-defined role specifications the orchestrator adopts per phase
multi_agent_topology.note: 41 roles are prompts adopted by one orchestrator. Parallel review council and optional worktree streams exist on Claude Code only.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: parallelism comes from the blind review council, the adversarial reviewer, and optional git-worktree streams on Claude Code, sequential on other providers
delegation_mechanism.note: Optional worktree streams could qualify as subagent_spawn; the default is unclear.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: loki modernize heal ./your-repo --strict # block ALL behavioral change without approval
human_in_loop.note: The default autonomous run uses --dangerously-skip-permissions. loki steer / pause provide steering. Approval is opt-in via --strict.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
The second command consumes `.loki/state/pr-title.txt` and
`.loki/state/pr-body.md` byte-for-byte.
short_term_state.note: The .loki/state directory, task queue and checklist persist.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Episodic/semantic/procedural memory with vector search; knowledge learned on one project surfaces on the next
long_term_memory.note: See memory/engine.py. Vector search is optional.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
bind-mounting the current folder so `.loki`
state and resume work exactly like local

self_verification.evidence_quote: Static analysis, test suite (pass/fail), blind 3-reviewer code review with severity blocking, anti-sycophancy Devil's Advocate

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Code is not "done" until it passes automated verification.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
It stops when the completion council votes
stop (`council_should_stop` in `autonomy/completion-council.sh`), a completion
promise is met, max iterations is hit
termination_condition.note: The stagnation valve suggests stall_detection. --max-budget-usd is passed to the provider.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
Opus for planning/architecture, Sonnet for development, Haiku for
unit tests and simple parallel work

timeouts.note: autonomy/lib/deadline.py exists, but its content is not in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Every other command continues to execute on the existing Bash CLI (`autonomy/loki`)
execution_isolation.note: Runs locally by default. Optional Docker image, and sandbox.sh / Dockerfile.sandbox.

network_policy.note: sandbox.sh and seccomp config exist, but their content is not in the evidence.

permission_model.note: The policy engine is an enterprise opt-in. autonomy/hooks/validate-bash.sh exists.

TLS, OIDC bearer-token validation (the foundation for SSO; browser SAML login is
roadmap), scoped RBAC, OTEL tracing, policy engine, audit trails.
